summary: Name resembles vue-demi with placeholder content only
details: Package name closely resembles the widely-used `vue-demi` package but ships only a placeholder containing a single `console.log("Hello from my npx tool!")`. There are no install-time lifecycle hooks, no network calls, no shell execution, no credential or filesystem access, and no functional re-export of the real `vue-demi`. Name-similarity to a popular package without any installer-harm payload is a subjective confusion-risk signal worth a human review of intent (placeholder/abandoned squat vs. confusion attack), but does not constitute a confirmed supply-chain attack.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
